purpose: Recover small cars that disappear when full images are downsampled or the vehicle is partially occluded, using only current RGB evidence, agreement across distinct crop windows and previously fixed detections.
selection: Use four independent development roads and 699 archived validation frames. Apply every native quality gate, both archive floors, plus an intact gain or a small-car omission control with a bounded false-positive cost. Rank the additional true detections minus half the additional false detections, then small-car omission recoveries and stricter threshold. Exclude all consumed holdouts from threshold selection.
evaluation: Seal source, development selection, the prior nomination and the geometry before new 81-frame acquisition on road 60, site 442. Re-evaluate all seven previous sets and the earlier bus-failure site 307. Preserve original masked GT, metrics, YOLOX comparison and all failure records.
development_diagnosis: At a 0.70 two-window confidence threshold, all 43 added false positives on development road 3 matched the same annotated excluded car (visible box height 3.75 in the scoring grid). Require a one-pixel localization margin above the four-pixel annotation floor for additional boxes. Keep the unmodified official scoring rules and count every FP.
